description: The stored prices shown on a SlabLineage card page: the SL Consensus price and the PSA / TAG market prices across grades, with the same labels the page uses. Values are USD. The card page's raw (ungraded) price is returned separately as raw, or null when the page shows none.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id (the number in https://slablineage.com/card/{id}).

name: get_card_price
title: Card prices
